secondOriginalTopology.scope: Position-welded topology analysis only; no hole fill, GUI/MCP or native comparison. This topology reports a nonmanifold edge; it is not the application's imported indexed representation.

indexedImport.scope: Shared indexed importer and topology analysis; no fill, rendered GUI/MCP or native comparison.

successfulPartialCacheMemory.scope: Matched isolated indexed worker fill with topology cache; no GUI, public MCP, native comparison, or full serialization memory measurement.

thirdOriginalMemory.scope: Worker-level isolated diagnostics; all six tested arcs were skipped. Not a successful large-scan fill or a GUI/MCP/native comparison.

originalScan.driver: SCANFORGE_BRIDGE_CASES=original-partial and SCANFORGE_ORIGINAL_PARTIAL_SOURCE pointing to the pinned scan-1.stl
originalScan.failedRuns: The first driver selected by topology index rather than displayed order. The second selected correctly but exported while the workspace was busy. Both failed and cleaned up; the corrected driver passed.
originalScan.mixedDriverRegression: The native Semi/Tangent, original-scan partial Tangent and native Flat Bridge cases passed in one isolated run after resetting the test project and target between scenarios.

limitations: One manufactured partial Tangent native control; no general native parity claim.
The other directed arc was checked for cache consistency, not compared with a separate native export.
Multi-boundary separated-patch cache and crossing-patch rejection controls are manufactured; their large-input cost is not measured.
Other partial and bridge algorithms and the M2 acceptance gates remain open.
